subtests.name: Navigating right should move the focus to the next column, skipping the non-focusable cell.
Navigating down should move the focus to the next row, skipping the non-focusable cell.
Navigating left should move to the previous column, skipping the non-focusable cell.
Navigating up should move the focus to the previous row, skipping the non-focusable cell.
